source_time_note: The additional SHORT fixture keeps market, financial acquisition, simulated fill and later Core event distinct. Its synthetic market was advanced explicitly past the financial assessment and fill; the existing episode time check was preserved.

semantics.S01: Original kernel and native quantity; fees/funding counted once, no extra slippage debit; separate mark/FX/as-of.
semantics.S11: Durable original budget close/loss latch, idempotence, cold read, no fill/flat/release from intent.
semantics.S12: Original per-slot safety input, separate writers/permits and preserved foreign holds.
semantics.P11_P12: Confirmed simulated fill and original episode identity/current cursor; no ACK-to-fill or reload-to-opening shortcut.

covered_effects: Natural LONG N1 entry and original simulated fill/accounting -> target-slot loss trigger -> existing Safety exit and full close handoff.

Missing/foreign/stale/future mark/FX/episode data do not invent a loss; original Time Exit remains reachable.
Durable pending close survives improved mark and idempotent reobservation.
Original close fill, Flat, reconciliation, economic close record, no new Entry after exhaustion, and cold restart.
Missing/rehash-forged records rejected; late original entry-budget reader consumes loss latch; failed guard persistence fences original owner.
